about: EDU-EP16-SHORT blip clock (storyboard EDU-EP16-SHEETS-R1 'Blip clock'; Boss W5.2, 2026-11-15). One clock for the trace picture (src/painted/edu16/clock.ts reads this file) and the BLIP sound S02 (Ton/Editor place one blip at each spike frame). Frames are composition frames (scene offset 0, 30 fps). Each spike is drawn for 3 frames (1, 0.62, 0.28). The trace is flat from flatFrom; missing is the first blip that never comes (W-STOP, riser S12 cuts dead there).
